name: katok-reply-reuse
description: Find and reuse the user's own past KakaoTalk replies instead of generating an AI-sounding rewrite.

interface.shortDescription: Reuse your real past KakaoTalk replies with provenance
interface.longDescription: Search an authorized macOS KakaoTalk archive, rank user-authored past replies, and return exact reuse or explicit placeholder substitution without automatic sending.
defaultPrompt: Find how I answered a similar KakaoTalk message before.
Reuse my own past wording for this reply.
